TS0220001.solution: List Sources to find an existing id.

TS0220002.message: A Source with id '{id}' already exists.
TS0220002.solution: Choose a different id, or replace the existing Source with its current ETag.

TS0220003.message: Source id '{bodyId}' in the request body does not match path id '{pathId}'.
TS0220003.solution: Use the same immutable Source id in the request path and body.

TS0220004.message: Source '{id}' requires its current ETag for this operation.
TS0220004.solution: Read the Source, then retry with its ETag in If-Match.

TS0220005.message: Source '{id}' changed after it was read.
TS0220005.solution: Read the current Source and retry the operation with its new ETag.

TS0220006.solution: Remove those references before deleting the Source.

TS0220007.message: Source '{id}' cannot change srs.enabled while these pipelines are still reading it: {pipelines}.
TS0220007.solution: Stop those pipelines, then change srs.enabled. Pausing is not enough: a paused pipeline has only suspended its engine, and its capture is still reading the source.
